tasks.name: recto-winui-pin
tasks.description: Propose the latest stable WinUI 3 release on a winui/<version> branch and email the operator

tasks.name: recto-toolchain-pins
tasks.description: Email once per new C++/WinRT or Windows SDK build tools release; fail on a non-stable pin

tasks.name: recto-windows-sdk-line
tasks.description: Email once when a newer Windows SDK line than WindowsTargetPlatformVersion ships

tasks.name: recto-actions-pins
tasks.description: Propose GitHub Actions at their latest stable majors on a pins/actions-<key> branch and email the operator

tasks.name: recto-vcpkg-baseline
tasks.description: Propose the latest vcpkg release baseline on a pins/vcpkg-<tag> branch after build.cmd passes

tasks.name: recto-python-pin
tasks.description: Email once when CI or this machine's Python is behind the newest stable CPython

tasks.name: recto-visual-studio
tasks.description: Email once when this machine's Visual Studio is behind its latest servicing release

tasks.name: recto-conclave-kits
tasks.description: Email once when Conclave SDK kit files drift from the SDK or its doctor reports a gap
